reason: Entries: mark_part2 (LDX #0, fall-through), mark_part3 (LDX #2; BRA mark_part); callers only draw_mover's part two/three (render.6502 1555, 1568), each followed by ren_draw_sprite; put_on only writes the operands via the base_lo/header_lo/base_hi/header_hi labels, which stay *+1 of their instructions. Exit RTS: A = entry A, N/Z from LDA as from PLA, C from the second SBC (unchanged by PLA or LDA zp), V from SBC either way, X, Y untouched, S same (PHA/PLA net zero; no stack use now). Only new effect: a write to &CB (rows_m1). In the renderer &CB is written before read everywhere: draw_column.each writes it before the cell loop reads it; restore_block writes it before its cell loop; compiled_part/kc_part/sky code do not use it. Outside the renderer &CB is only scenery_layer_flip (game.6502 1150 write in get_sprite_and_flip, 1222 read in get_scenery_y_sprite_and_flip_for_layer_Y, every path to the read goes through get_scenery_type or get_mountain_or_cloud_type -> get_sprite_and_flip first, in the same call chain), so it is dead across a render; restore_game_zp does not save/restore &CB (and draw_column/restore_block already clobber it in the render). No interrupt-time code touches &CB in play (bank5/credits use &CB only on the front end, where the MOS owns vsync and the renderer does not run). Cycles: PHA 3 + PLA 4 = 7 vs STA zp 3 + LDA zp 3 = 6: 1 saved per call. Bytes: +2 (PHA/PLA 1 each, STA/LDA zp 2 each). Layout effects (bank 4 sliding up 2, branch page crossings, REN_BASE ASSERT) are the machine/project lenses' and the gate's.
